params.topic: Japan J1 2018-2025 incremental BTTS and 1X2 evidence for fixture-key joins
questions: For each discoverable J1 fixture in seasons 2018-2025, return a stable fixture identity with season, official date, home team, away team, kickoff local/UTC when available, round, venue and source URL.
Return the verified 90-minute result and explicit BTTS target label: btts_1plus_each_90=yes/no/unavailable. Do not use extra time, penalties or aggregate results for the 90-minute BTTS label.

Return 1X2 bookmaker evidence for Bet365, Pinnacle and William Hill when available, with explicit axis home/draw/away, field semantic opening/pre_closing/closing/earliest_verified_pre_match/latest_verified_pre_match, captured_at, source URL, final URL, locator and raw evidence SHA-256. A snapshot must not be relabeled as true opening or a full interval.

Report coverage, unavailable fields, source failures and cross-source conflicts separately. Preserve unresolved duplicate or difficult provider pairings with the competing identity keys; do not silently deduplicate.
Return a machine-readable audit with expected, discovered, complete, partial, missing, conflict counts and an unresolved_queue.
prohibited: Do not generate Qimen charts, palace/five-element fields, model direction, structure selection, probabilities, Gold, Snapshot, Outcome or Review.
Do not infer missing odds, BTTS results, round, venue or kickoff values.
Do not call closing/pre-closing/earliest/latest a true opening or a complete O_INTERVAL without same-bookmaker time evidence.

dp_reason: This request is a bounded historical evidence collection task; Muse should use deterministic source retrieval and return provenance, not DeepSeek judgment.
